ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached figure, a rectangular block is placed on a rough horizontal surface, and on the right side of the block there is a horizontal arrow labeled F pointing to the right, indicating that the pulling force is to the right; the block will move to the right on the horizontal surface, so the direction of kinetic friction is to the left. Reasoning: It is known that m=2 kg, F=16 N, μk=0.2, g=10 m/s^2, the object starts moving from rest, and the time for which the pulling force acts is t=2 s. When the object moves on the horizontal surface, the normal force N=mg=2×10=20 N, so the kinetic friction f=μkN=0.2×20=4 N. During the first 2 s, the net force in the horizontal direction is Fnet=16−4=12 N, therefore the acceleration a=Fnet/m=12/2=6 m/s^2. Starting from rest, the velocity at the end of 2 s is v=at=6×2=12 m/s. At this time the kinetic energy Ek=1/2 mv^2=1/2×2×12^2=144 J. After the pulling force is removed, in the horizontal direction it is acted on only by kinetic friction, and the magnitude of the deceleration af=f/m=4/2=2 m/s^2. From the stopping process formula 0=v^2−2afs, obtain s=v^2/(2af)=12^2/(2×2)=36 m.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: a block is on a horizontal rough surface, and a horizontal force arrow F points to the right, so the pull and initial motion are horizontal and friction acts to the left. From the text read m=2 kg, F=16 N, μk=0.2, t=2 s, g=10 m/s^2, and the object starts from rest. Compute kinetic friction during motion as f=μmg=0.2×2×10=4 N. During the first 2 s, use Newton's second law horizontally: Fnet=16−4=12 N, so a=Fnet/m=6 m/s^2. Then use constant-acceleration kinematics from rest: v=at=6×2=12 m/s. Kinetic energy at 2 s is K=1/2 mv^2=144 J. After the force is removed, only kinetic friction acts horizontally, giving deceleration a_f=f/m=2 m/s^2 opposite the motion. Use stopping kinematics 0=v^2−2a_f s, so s=v^2/(2a_f)=36 m.

推理：已知 m=2 kg，F=16 N，μk=0.2，g=10 m/s^2，初速度为 0，拉力作用时间 t=2 s。水平面上支持力 N=mg=2×10=20 N，所以动摩擦力 f=μkN=0.2×20=4 N。

3. 拉力撤去后，只受摩擦力阻碍运动。由功-能定理：0−144=−4s，解得 s=36 m。
